Name: Galadandé
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
**Galadandé**

**Title** The Heavenly Song
**Gemstone** Orange Citrine
**Type** Pleromael
**Originator** T’quinn

The Heavenly Song was a trusted friend of T’quinn during the Age of Sunderance - a celestial beast that her original servants looked to for guidance from time to time. When she settled into her station as an eidolic deity, Galadandé was elevated to the power of an eidolos with the promise that it would continue to guide mankind in times of great need. In addition to that, Galadandé willingly serves as a mount for T’quinn when she requires one, and is included in imagery of her quite often. Galadandé is said to reside within the Midnight Peaks.

Stat Blocks.ability_note: *checks, saves and skills above include the +1 cosmogony bonus

traits.name: Cosmogony Bonus (+2)
traits.description: Half of Galadandé’s Cosmogony Bonus is added to their attack rolls, ability checks, damage rolls and saving throws. The full bonus is added to their armor class. The bonus to their attack rolls, saving throws, damage rolls and armor class is accounted for in this stat block.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
Galadandé’s spellcasting ability is Wisdom. They can cast the following spells, requiring no components:

At will: major image (6th-level), thaumaturgy
1/Day each: flame strike, resurrection
2/Day each: banishment, calm emotions, create food and water, greater restoration, plane shift, protection from evil and good, revivify, wind walk
3/Day each: cure wounds, dispel magic, lesser restoration, sending

Galadandé’s spells are cast as though using a 3rd-level spell slot unless they would already be higher.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Galadandé makes two Hoof attacks then one Citrine Horn attacks, or makes two Radiant Spear attacks.

actions.name: Hoof
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) force damage plus 6 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Citrine Horn
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Spear
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Cosmic Shard: Song of Rain and Light (Recharge 6)
actions.description:
Galadandé produces a harmonious melody that can be heard for great distances, but is strongest in a 300-foot radius sphere surrounding it. This melody lasts for 1 minute, during which time each creature hostile to Galadandé who starts their turn within it must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failure they are illuminated by radiant light until the start of their next turn, and cannot benefit from being invisible - creatures who are naturally invisible become visible. While illuminated this way they cannot gain advantage on attacks against Galadandé, and each time they make a weapon attack or cast a spell they take 1d8 radiant damage.

Creatures who are allied to Galadandé who start their turn within this light cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws or ability checks, and all damage they take is reduced by 10 points.

Galadandé must concentrate on this effect as though it was a spell, but they can concentrate on it and a second effect (or spell) together as though they were one effect.

options.name: Move
options.description: Galadandé moves up to half its movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

options.name: Smite
options.description: Galadandé makes one Horn, Citrine Horn or Radiant Spear attack.

options.name: Unleash Inspiration (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Galadandé grants inspiration and guidance to three creatures that can see or hear it within 120 feet, which remains until the start of Galadandé’s next turn. Each of these creatures rolls a d6 each time they make an attack roll, ability check or saving throw and adds it to the result.
